# English-Shayari.com

> A curated platform featuring 145+ English shayari collections spanning love, life, attitude, and sad poetry for emotional expression.

English-Shayari.com is a dedicated shayari platform founded by Ananya Sharma that bridges Hindi, Urdu, and English poetry traditions. The site specializes in 2-line emotional verses and inspirational poetry across multiple themes and moods.

## Key Topics

- English Shayari
- Love Shayari
- Life Shayari (Zindagi)
- Attitude Shayari
- Sad Shayari
- Emotional Poetry
- Hindi-Urdu Poetry
- 2-Line Shayari
- Inspirational Verses
- English-Hindi Shayari
- Heartbreak Poetry
- Motivational Poetry
- Urdu Poetry
- Emotional Verses
- Poetry Collections

## Shayari Collections

- [Best 145+ English Shayari for Girls and Boys 2025](https://english-shayari.com): Homepage showcasing 145+ English Shayari collection with love, life, and attitude poetry
- [Batest 135+ Heart Touching Love Shayari in English 2026](https://english-shayari.com/love-shayari-in-english): Collection of 135+ romantic love shayari in English with heart-touching 2-line verses
- [Latest 135+ Life Shayari in English - Zindagi Shayari 2026](https://english-shayari.com/life-shayari-in-english): 135+ Zindagi (life) shayari in English with inspirational and emotional verses
- [Latest 135+ Attitude Shayari English - 2026](https://english-shayari.com/attitude-shayari-english): 135+ attitude shayari in English featuring motivational and swagger-themed poetry
- [Latest 135+ Sad Shayari in English 2026](https://english-shayari.com/sad-shayari-in-english): 135+ sad shayari in English exploring loneliness, heartbreak, and emotional verses
